rcSource: plan line main changes (the plan's recorded change set)
citation: The decide stage's membership filter: the plan's change set records only release-worthy (bump-resolving) commits — compatibility matrix row A, Revert-commits cell ('the change set records only release-worthy changes'), pinned as scenario S-04 (bump-driving independent of changelog-worthiness, assemble.test.ts); the changelog renderer renders exactly that recorded plan (row E1, #226). Release-please's committed changelog instead renders every conventionally-typed commit in the window: loom's 0.6.0 section holds 75 entries over 69 distinct commits (six shas appear twice — b230fef, 11034ca, 135dc2d, 278167a, 546c8c5, 68f6c72, once with a PR reference and once with the bare commit link) where the recomputed plan selects 31; archkeep's 0.29.0 section carries three docs entries the plan does not select.

citation: The Release-PR gate's deterministic render (src/app/release-pr.ts): the title is the gate's own render of the recorded plan, deliberately not configurable — configuration would make the identity surface mutable (compatibility matrix row F4, PR title/body patterns). The live create leg read the projected title back exactly as rendered (decision D81, PR #313).

rpSource: merged PR #905 body (gh pr view), structure only — the bytes stay in the recorded artifact
citation: The identity contract: the body is the claim marker (component, line, target, plan fingerprint) plus the plan render — parseable identity content, never a title/label pattern (compatibility matrix row F2, detect & update; src/app/release-pr.ts §1). Decision D81 proves the marker live: the created draft was adopted by its marker alone and a tampered body was refused as plan-conflict without a rewrite. Release-please's body is a bot-authored changelog carrier — a generated-by header and a version heading, no parseable identity claim.

rcSource: renderReleasePRProjection labels (the constant, state-free organizational label)
citation: Compatibility matrix row F3 (pending-state labels `autorelease: pending`): RELEASE-PLEASE QUIRK deliberately not adopted — label-based state is replaced by claim/attempt identity in ledger refs. Observed on all three consumers' merged release PRs: `autorelease: tagged` rides alongside organizational labels (`documentation`, `size/s`); release-craft's projection carries the one constant organizational label `release-craft`.

citation: The renderer's declared-sections contract (src/planner/changelog.ts, pinned by changelog.test.ts): declaration order is the render order and a type the declaration does not name surfaces under its own capitalized heading, never dropped (compatibility matrix row E5) — action-agents declares no changelog-sections, so `fix` renders as `Fix` where release-please's preset maps it to `Bug Fixes`. On loom and archkeep the absent `Documentation` header is the selected-changes membership law rendered: the plan selects no docs commits, so the declared Documentation section has nothing to render (row A).
